trustValues.title: Professional review, not diagnosis
trustValues.description: NEXBODY systems produce structured assessment reports for clinicians, coaches and operators. Results are not a substitute for medical diagnosis or treatment.

trustValues.title: Capabilities kept separate
trustValues.description: X60 covers posture, composition and neck-shoulder mobility. OneScan covers gait and plantar pressure. F20 covers 3D foot morphology. Claims are not mixed across products.

trustValues.title: Data you can hand over
trustValues.description: Email sharing, printing, optional institution branding and interface upload keep reports inside the facility workflow.

trustValues.title: Configurable for each site
trustValues.description: Thresholds, languages and data-cleaning options can be set for rehabilitation, fitness, sports and research environments.
